tools.name: list_vehicles
tools.title: List vehicles
tools.description: List vehicles owned by the authenticated user using an opaque cursor for pagination. Vehicles appear only after the user has scanned a car with the OBD Vault mobile app; when there are none, the result carries a notice explaining what the user has to do.

tools.name: get_vehicle_profile
tools.title: Get vehicle profile
tools.description: Get factual metadata and coverage for one vehicle. VIN is excluded unless explicitly requested.

vehicle_id.description: Optional vehicle ID. Defaults to the primary vehicle if omitted.

tools.name: get_latest_status
tools.title: Get latest vehicle status
tools.description: Get a comprehensive snapshot of the vehicle in a single call: latest diagnostic scan with key metrics (coolant, RPM, voltage), active/pending DTCs, the most recent completed driving trip (km, duration, fuel L/100km with its source: recorded, or the app's after-trip estimate with its coverage, speed, RPM), recent driving anomalies from the last 30 days, and active connection status.

tools.name: list_scan_sessions
tools.title: List scan sessions
tools.description: List diagnostic scan and driving sessions for a vehicle, including duration, distance, observation count, and trip indicators. Filterable by time or cursor. Vehicle ID defaults to primary vehicle.

vehicle_id.description: Optional vehicle ID. Defaults to the user's primary vehicle if omitted.

tools.name: get_scan_session
tools.title: Get scan session
tools.description: Get one bounded scan session including pre-computed telemetry metrics summary (peaks/averages for speed, coolant, voltage, RPM), diagnostic trouble codes, monitor readiness, the control units that answered a manufacturer dialogue (type, software and part numbers, their own fault memory), and sample observations.

tools.name: get_dtc_history
tools.title: Get DTC history
tools.description: List stored and pending diagnostic trouble code events for a vehicle, newest first, using an opaque cursor for pagination. Each event carries detected_at (start of the session that read it); code_summary gives each code's first and last sighting, so a code that has not been read for a long time is not mistaken for a current fault.

vehicle_id.description: Optional vehicle ID. Defaults to the primary vehicle if omitted.

tools.name: get_dtc_context
tools.title: Get DTC context
tools.description: Return the Mode 02 freeze frame stored with a DTC and the readings within ±30s (or custom) of it. The window is centred on the freeze frame capture when one exists, otherwise on the start of the session that recorded the DTC (see target_time_source). Vehicle and DTC code default to the latest if omitted.

dtc_code.description: Optional diagnostic trouble code (e.g. P0101). If omitted, defaults to the latest recorded DTC.

timestamp.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp to center the analysis window around.

vehicle_id.description: Optional vehicle ID. Defaults to the user's primary vehicle if omitted.

window_seconds.description: Time window in seconds before and after the event (default 30s).

tools.name: aggregate_observations
tools.title: Summarize telemetry observations
tools.description: Calculate statistical aggregates (min, max, mean, count) for an observed metric. Supports filtering by vehicle, metric, scan_session_id, or time range. Use this tool instead of pulling raw observation lists when looking for peaks, extremes, or averages. Only measured values are aggregated: the app's after-trip fuel estimates are left out (get_latest_status and get_scan_session report them, labelled).

bucket.description: Time bucket for aggregation. Default is "day", or "all" to aggregate the entire queried range or session into one summary.

metric_key.description: The observed telemetry metric to aggregate (e.g. vehicle_speed, coolant_temperature, adapter_atrv_voltage, engine_rpm). Battery voltage measured at the adapter (ATRV) is adapter_atrv_voltage; control_module_voltage is the ECU's own supply reading (PID 42), which many cars do not report.

scan_session_id.description: Optional scan session ID to aggregate observations for a specific trip or scan.

timezone.description: IANA time zone that defines hour, day, week and month boundaries (e.g. Europe/Warsaw). Default UTC.

vehicle_id.description: Vehicle ID. Optional if scan_session_id is provided.

tools.name: get_observations
tools.title: Get telemetry observations
tools.description: Return raw sensor timeseries observations (RPM, coolant, trims, voltages, speed). Sorted DESC (newest-first) by default; supports ASC. Use cursor for pagination. Ideal for waveform analysis or detailed moment-by-moment debugging.

metric_key.description: Filter by specific telemetry metric (e.g. vehicle_speed, engine_rpm, coolant_temperature, adapter_atrv_voltage). Battery voltage measured at the adapter (ATRV) is adapter_atrv_voltage; control_module_voltage is the ECU's own supply reading (PID 42), which many cars do not report.

order.description: Chronological order: "desc" (newest first, default) or "asc" (oldest first).

scan_session_id.description: Filter observations by scan session ID.

vehicle_id.description: Vehicle ID. Optional if scan_session_id is provided.

tools.name: get_data_quality
tools.title: Get data quality
tools.description: Return factual coverage counts and observed metric keys for a vehicle.

vehicle_id.description: Optional vehicle ID. Defaults to the primary vehicle if omitted.

tools.name: create_vehicle_export
tools.title: Create vehicle data export
tools.description: Create a bounded read-only JSON or CSV export for an owned vehicle, with up to 1,000 observations per session. Use get_observations with next_cursor to retrieve complete sensor histories.
